lines.en: Eight legs on wet stone.
I climb up along the cave wall.
The crack is narrow; I fit through.
My steps sound like dripping water.
I can walk backwards too. Don't wonder.

lines.zh: 丝从腹下拉出来，铺在路上。
lines.en: Silk trails from my abdomen, marking the way.
The sulfur smell is ahead.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，石头不知道。
lines.en: I step lightly; the stone doesn't know.
I never lose my way in the dark.
A swarm of my brothers follows behind.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你的手指还细。
lines.en: My legs are thinner than your fingers.

lines.zh: 岩顶上倒挂着，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Hanging from the roof, I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 这条洞道我爬过上千次。
lines.en: I've crawled this tunnel a thousand times.
Don't bring a torch; it stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，腿先到。
lines.en: I squeeze from the crack, legs first.

lines.zh: 硫黄的墙上有我的旧丝。
lines.en: My old silk is on the sulfur wall.
I crouch on my silk and wait.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛各自看着一边。
lines.en: Each of my eight eyes watches a way.

lines.zh: 洞顶在滴水，滴在我背上。
lines.en: Water drips from the roof onto my back.
My fangs open and close slowly.
There isn't a bit of light here.
The sulfur walls glow dull yellow.
I hear footsteps far away.
Hairs on my legs feel the draft.

lines.zh: 我吐出一小段丝，没什么用。
lines.en: I spin a little silk for nothing.
The cave is quiet, except for me.
I count the drips; I lose count.
The dark is where I belong.
You brought light in here.

lines.zh: 我抬头，八只眼睛都对着你。
lines.en: I look up; all eight eyes on you.
You're much taller than the opening.
Your boots are trembling.

lines.zh: 我看得见你的血管在跳。
lines.en: I can see your veins pulsing.
You smell of torch smoke.

lines.zh: 我停在离你一臂的地方。
lines.en: I stop an arm's length away.
You shouldn't shine that here.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，腿动了一下。
lines.en: I tilt slightly and shift one leg.
You're standing on my silk.
One of my legs is broken.
I can still crawl.
You stepped on me.
I curl into a ball.
A crack splits my shell.
I make a thin, shrill sound.
This cave isn't safe now.
I retreat into the crack.
My silk has been trampled.
It hurts, but I'll bite again.
I don't eat what's in your hand.
Too sweet a smell. Cloying.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高些，我不跳。
lines.en: Raise the bread; I won't jump.

lines.zh: 我只对会动的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: I only care for things that move.
What you hold won't run.
Put it away; I'd rather have you.
I go around that bit of food.
My fangs don't chew such things.
Shaking food at the cave mouth is foolish.

lines.zh: 食物的味道压不住你的味道。
lines.en: The food can't mask your scent.

lines.zh: 我的腿缠上你的靴子了。
lines.en: My legs caught on your boot.
Don't step; I'm right by your foot.
I crawl past, brushing against you.
You walked into my silk.
I'm smaller, but I don't yield.
The stone's slick; we collided.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你裤脚上勾了一下。
lines.en: A leg snagged your trouser cuff.
Move; I'm going up the wall.

lines.zh: 你退后时踩断了我一根丝。
lines.en: You snapped a thread backing away.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个石缝里。
lines.en: We're crammed in the same crack.
I tap the stone with my front legs.

lines.zh: 你听见那阵轻轻的敲击吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that soft tapping?

lines.zh: 洞里没有风，气味散不开。
lines.en: No wind here; scents linger.
I edge slowly toward your silk.
Our eight legs weave together.
You click your fangs; I understand.
Deep in the crack it's quiet enough.

lines.zh: 这个丝囊会留在岩壁上。
lines.en: This egg sac will stay on the rock.
Don't wake the bats above us.
We slip away along the ceiling.
I pick up a shard of bone.
This thing stuck to my silk.
I drag it back into the cave.
A glinting pebble. Mine.
I carry it between my legs.
What falls belongs to the cave.
Not food, but good nest lining.
I bite it; it's hard.

lines.zh: 有人把东西落在洞里了。
lines.en: Someone left this thing in the cave.
I wrap it slowly in silk.
Something warm came into the cave.
I feel the tremor of footsteps.
That shape is breathing.
My legs knew first.
The silk is trembling softly.
Prey is coming down from above.
I turn toward that warmth.
All eight eyes lock on together.
There's a new smell in the cave.
I stop at the center of the web.
My brothers smell it too.
This one won't get away.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩壁绕到你背后。
lines.en: I circle the wall to your back.
Turn around; you still won't see me.
I shorten the distance bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我的腿在石上敲出节奏。
lines.en: My legs tap a rhythm on stone.
Your torch is burning down.
I'm waiting for your light to die.
I've blocked the way out.
Don't climb; above is mine.
I lie still, not moving at all.
The silk has reached your feet.
Do you hear that thin rustling?
I'm one step from you.
My fangs sink in.
The venom goes through my fangs.
I hang from your calf.
Are you getting dizzy yet?
I bite down once more.
I leap at your hand.
You missed your footing on the stone.
My legs wrap around your wrist.
The bite's light; the venom isn't.
I back off and wait for you to fall.
I crawl out of the dark.
Not a ray of light here. Perfect.
The crack opens and I slip out.
The sulfur corner suits me best.

lines.zh: 我的第一口空气是酸的。
lines.en: My first air tastes sour.
A swarm of kin wakes with me.

lines.zh: 我在岩壁上铺下第一根丝。
lines.en: I lay my first thread on the wall.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水打湿了我。
lines.en: Drips from the roof wet me.
The world above is far too bright.
I retreat into deeper black.
Fire seared my legs; they curl.

lines.zh: 从洞顶摔下去，腿摊开了。
lines.en: Fell from the ceiling, legs splayed.
Water over my back; I hold still.
The stone caved in on me.
Something pinned through my abdomen.
Light stabs all eight of my eyes.
Nothing left to hunt in here.
Thunder crawled down the crack.
No wall to grip; I keep falling.
